attribution: Numeric facts derived from Department of Finance Canada, Major Federal Transfers - Monthly payments made to provinces and territories, at the linked original URL. This is an independent transformed dataset, not an official or endorsed government product.
limits: Nova Scotia rows only; no all-Canada coverage claim.
Blank source cells remain null, not zero; territorial financing is not a Nova Scotia program.
CHT deduction and reimbursement columns vary by month and are retained separately. Primary-column sums are not a net-CHT total.
Reported cash payments cannot simply be subtracted from provincial accrued revenue or partial-year budgets.
Source explains October payments can include prior-year allocation adjustments and March can include health-transfer deductions or reimbursements.
This is government-to-government payment disclosure, not proof of vendor expenditure or services delivered.
No federal wordmark, logos, original narrative or whole tables are republished.

publication.reason: Reviewed factual projection only; exact independent acceptance receipt also required.
